ICYMI: I recently announced a big initiative for 2026 that I want to make sure you saw. Look: We need Democrats to win in 2026. Because we can’t afford another two years of an unchecked and unbound Trump Administration. And families literally cannot afford any more inaction on the affordability crisis. But we can’t just talk the talk about this being the most important election of our lifetimes. We have to put our money where our mouth is. So I recently donated over $400,000 from my campaign account to 23 state parties to help Democrats win up and down the ballot in November. [**I’ll share more on my decision below, and if you’re able to pitch in $28 or anything you can to support our campaign, you’ll ensure we can continue launching important initiatives like this one.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3496?amount=28&t=8&akid=2802%2E4032634%2EgdiLgy) I took a hard look at the election map for 2026. I did the math and identified 23 really good pickup opportunities for Democrats. Alaska. Arizona. California. Colorado. Florida. Georgia. Iowa. Kentucky. Maine. Michigan. Minnesota. Mississippi. Nebraska. New Hampshire. New York. New Jersey. Nevada. North Carolina. Ohio. Pennsylvania. Texas. Virginia. Wisconsin. These states are home to some of the most competitive races of the cycle — and where this money can make a real difference for a majority in Congress and taking back power in state legislatures and Governor offices. These are elections that we can win if we invest in state infrastructure early and we can take on the billionaires and big corporations throwing money into these races. **This money is from supporters like you who have pitched in to strengthen our campaign fighting for big, structural change. I don’t take your financial contributions lightly, and this is one of the best ways to guarantee we can actually make our plans a reality.** **Because we can only make this change if we have the Democratic majorities to fight for it.** [**You make this work possible, and there’s a lot more we have to do as a team in order to fight hard and win big in 2026. So, if you’re able, please pitch in $28 or anything you can to our campaign so we can take back power in 2026, stop Trump’s unchecked corruption, and pass our plans to make our government work for working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3496?amount=28&t=9&akid=2802%2E4032634%2EgdiLgy) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/126957993/606511342/-675562864?amount=10&refcode=LOC_EM_FR_2026.03.09_Sherrod-Brown-Split_B1_F1_S1_C1_90OP_N-T0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmUwNjI1Zi1jMTFiLWYxMTEtYTY5YS0wMDBkM2ExZjBhOTciLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HfK-7AQ9YTdDBFYl5Cbzjw8UisSzen0CIavclbCiqTA=) **I’m sick of the two sets of rules in this country – one for the rich and well-connected, and one for everyone else.**

And I’m angry when I see politicians like my opponent, Jon Husted, protect their billionaire donors at all costs.

Here’s what happened: Husted received more than $116,000 in donations from Jeffrey Epstein’s co-conspirator Leslie Wexner.

Then recently, Wexner testified before Congress about his relationship with Epstein and admitted to backing Husted, saying, “I’m sure I helped him. I helped him politically.”

And it gets worse. Husted didn’t just take Wexner’s money – **he accepted a maximum donation _just weeks_ before voting to block the release of the Epstein files.**

You do the math.

This is why when people say the system is rigged, they’re right. Politically connected insiders avoid consequences as victims are pushed aside. Billionaires get tax breaks while working families pay more for health insurance. And elites do whatever the hell they want while regular folks are told to just be grateful and “earn more.”

Most observers are analyzing the recent activities in Venezuela and the US-Israeli strikes against Iran as isolated acts. Proponents note the world is safer without Maduro, the world's leading supporter of narcoterrorism, and the IRGC, the world's largest exporter of terrorism (a sentiment with which I agree). Opponents suggest these actions were brazen violations of sovereignty and will destabilize the world.
Both views may be missing the real story. When you step back and connect dots across energy markets, supply-chain dependencies, and the calendar of great-power diplomacy, a far more nuanced picture emerges: These moves may be the opening gambits in a grand strategy to strengthen Trump's negotiating position with Beijing before his trip to China on March 31. Let's **follow the oil** to see how this might be so.
China is the world's largest importer of crude oil, bringing in roughly 11.5 million barrels per day. Despite their green posturing and climate "leadership," the Chinese economy remains heavily dependent on fossil energy. Further, almost 40 percent of China's oil imports have origins in the Persian Gulf and come through the Strait of Hormuz. Interestingly, 80 percent of Iran's crude exports are bound for China, much of it via a "shadow fleet" of tankers designed to evade Western sanctions (not unlike the fleet used to ship Venezuelan oil to China). In short, two of China's most important sources of discounted, sanctions-skirting oil were Iran and Venezuela. The Trump Administration just upended both.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/37aac82d-762e-41d3-b456-66ed098e35a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The graphic above (thanks Claude!) reveals China's vulnerability. Russia, Iran, and Venezuela are all now under global sanctions pressure. These three countries provided 33 percent of China's crude imports. Add in the Gulf states (Saudi Arabia, Iraq, UAE, Kuwait, Oman) that are dependent upon the ability to transit through the Strait of Hormuz, and the percentage of China's imports that are vulnerable rises to around 50%.
#### _**(SIDE NOTE: Note the data above has China importing more oil from Malaysia than Malaysia produces! This is likely due to relabeling of sanctioned oil (probably from Iran and Venezuela) as Malaysian ...)**_

name: Tammy Baldwin
subject: Farmers are paying and borrowing more thanks to Trump
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TAMMY BALDWIN FOR SENATE
body:
|
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=5240%2E35263%2E4fdeD0)
Do you know how many Wisconsin farms declared bankruptcy in 2023 and 2024 combined? **Only two.** In 2025? **That number increased to 16.** Trump’s tariffs have made it impossible for family farms that have been supporting communities across Wisconsin for generations. Farmers are paying and borrowing more to grow their crops and purchase the necessary equipment to plant and harvest them, making it harder and harder to continue to run their businesses at a profit. For years, this district has been defined by national drama instead of local results. Shawn is offering something steadier: leadership rooted in service, respect, and the conviction that government should work for people who are working hard and still feeling the squeeze from rising costs. That contrast was on full display late last month when Donald Trump visited the district to attempt to defend his record on affordability. The truth is families in Northwest Georgia are living a different reality: Prices remain high, household budgets are under pressure, and voters are increasingly frustrated when political rhetoric does not line up with everyday life. Shawn is running to meet people where they are and to focus on work that will lead to lower everyday costs and better results from government. He has already shown that he can compete in this district by building a coalition of Democrats, Independents, veterans, rural voters, and common-sense Republicans who are ready for serious leadership in Congress. This race matters beyond Northwest Georgia. Because it is a special election, the margins are tight and the stakes are high. Shawn is running to meet people where they are and to focus on work that will lead to lower everyday costs and better results from government. He has already shown that he can compete in this district by building a coalition of Democrats, Independents, veterans, rural voters, and common-sense Republicans who are ready for serious leadership in Congress. # AZ-06 is Officially Red-to-Blue!
---
| | Team Mendoza is proud to announce that Jo has earned her spot on the [Democratic Congressional Campaign Committee’s Red to Blue Program](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=07647e6516&e=fea3203902)! The program recognizes top-tier campaigns that demonstrate they are on the path to flip a Republican held district.
Following the announcement, Jo released the following statement:
_“As a Marine, I took an oath to defend the Constitution of the United States, and that oath never expires. Now more than ever, we need tough, accountable leadership that will put our families first. While Juan Ciscomani votes with DC party leaders, families here are paying the price. I don’t answer to party bosses. I answer to Arizona. Our district is ready for an elected leader who shows up, stands firm, and gets results. Mission first. Arizona always.”_
The Red to Blue designation adds national momentum to Mendoza’s campaign, which already is powered by veterans, working families, and rural communities across AZ-06.
---

| |
# Valentines for Vets 🩷 🇺🇸
---
| | On Valentine's Day, Jo spent the day delivering valentines to veterans across Southern Arizona at numerous veteran service organizations.
Thank you to the students, volunteers, and community members who pitched in to make sure that those who sacrificed so much got a little extra love this year!

# Arizona’s Primary Date Changed!
---
| | In case you missed it, [a new state law](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=ecb217cebd&e=fea3203902) has changed the dates of the 2026 primary! This change shifts Arizona’s primary date back by two weeks - which also means our petition signature deadline is also 2 weeks earlier!
The new deadline to submit signatures is March 23rd, and we need more volunteers to ensure we get Jo on the ballot! We’re knocking on doors and calling voters multiple times a week and would love to have YOU join us.
Sign up to volunteer using the link below or send an email to claire@joannamendoza.com to get involved.
If you live in Arizona’s Sixth congressional district, you can also sign Jo’s petition online to help get her on the ballot. If you’ve already signed, share the link with **five** friends who live in the district!

# Jo is an EMILYs List Majority Maker!
---
| | In February, EMILYs List announced their [Mission Majority ](https://joannamendoza.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a848c5089d2c16d92422d70c8&id=b5b269eaba&e=fea3203902)Initiative to expand the House battlefield by working to flip the nation’s most competitive races - and AZ-06 is one of them!
The path to flipping the House run directly through AZ-06, and Team Mendoza is excited to keep up the momentum with EMILYs List.

| | The 2026 general election is **239 days away** \- and Jo is already out in the district, listening and meeting with constituents, and laying the groundwork to fight for southern Arizonans in DC. Stay tuned for when Jo will be in a community near you!

I've been through a lot – and I've also learned a lot. **The biggest takeaway of all is this:_Be prepared._**

“The Republicans should say, ‘We want to take over.’ We should take over the voting, the voting in at least many — 15 places. The Republicans ought to nationalize the voting.”
Trump made the statement on a podcast hosted by Dan Bongino, his former deputy F.B.I. director and a MAGA acolyte with a long history of election denial and spreading conspiracy theories related to our elections.
Let's recap recent history -- His administration has been:
* Attempting to seize control of voters’ private information
* Deploying immigration agents to states that don't give up voter data
* Using federal law enforcement agents to investigate his obsession with his loss in 2020
* Staffing his agencies with people who care more about pleasing him than following the law

Every day, I read stories and watch videos of innocent people being violently detained and uprooted from their lives to serve Trump’s sick political agenda.
As a human being, I’m completely repulsed by what's going on in our country.
As a father, I’m deeply worried for all the immigrant kids who are scared right now.
As a Congressman, I’m livid that Kristi Noem and Donald Trump are carrying out these attacks on innocent people – and trying to hide it from ANY oversight.
It’s my JOB to do this. As a member of the House Committee on Oversight, it’s my responsibility and legal right to hold these people to account.
But the MAGA loyalists in the White House and Senate have made clear they have zero respect for the law – or the basic rights of our neighbors.
This fight is personal to me. Trump’s policies are breaking apart families and putting lives in danger. So yes – I’m angry.

body:
Your support will help us fight back. Can we count on you today, Peter?
#
The 2026 midterms are officially underway, Peter – and what's about to happen is unlike anything we have ever seen.
**We’re talking about the most EXPENSIVE midterm election in American history.** Campaigns and outside groups are expected to spend upwards of $8 BILLION before November – on House races, Senate races, governor's races, and state legislative races up + down the ballot in all 50 states.
To understand what that means on the ground, look at North Carolina. One Senate seat. One race. Experts are projecting it alone could cost $1 BILLION.
Here's what's driving the spending:
**Democrats need to flip just 4 Senate seats to win back the majority. Republicans can only afford to lose 2.** Both parties know the map is narrow – and whoever controls the money will control the outcome.
So Republican mega-donors, corporate PACs, and billionaire networks are already writing massive checks.
They did it in 2024. They're doing it again, bigger, in 2026.
And here's the hard truth: If grassroots Democrats don't show up with real resources – early, and in large numbers – the other side will spend us into the ground before most voters have even started paying attention.
So this is where you come in, Peter.
**We're building a war chest that funds Democratic candidates up + down the ballot.** Not a billion-dollar super PAC. Just thousands upon thousands of people like you who understand what's at stake this year, giving what they can whenever it makes most sense for them.

Here's what's driving the spending: Democrats need to flip just 4 Senate seats to win back the majority. Republicans can only afford to lose 2. | | | | **Special event THIS THURSDAY, March 12th at 5:00PM in Paradise Valley for doctors who want a stronger voice in Congress!**
Dear Fellow Arizonan,
As physicians, we know that the most critical decisions in healthcare should stay between a doctor and their patient--not be dictated by federal bureaucrats. It's critical we have a STRONG VOICE in Congress with a national platform from the medical community to lead the fight against BIG HEALTHCARE and all they have done to decimate the practice of medicine and the doctor-patient relationship. I am a veteran and a proven leader in our medical community. I served as President of the Arizona Medical Association and I currently represent us in the [AMA House of Delegates](https://b9jvufebb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001mK9GHS_OaGHXNFOBryz-WDRe6CjdQNlkfgBvTks7gu47Y16J-1VIlzq_jup-WKXfgDWR_BXYObyH_TdrISRVolqwnLIiDyI7UIQSesaGhazCL9rQeqb8gOXz9VSafmu0-01jipn0RhNRqUg3hsZPYGUFmu8Gjt6WfHfxyTzGHNhW2gfiXpPAxYvP19p7mBT2NN_cIlN0A-EweI5PpLewJXA7ml08vSNblxqQ1Bcx4iJq4gxZdjOVKLGiWeU8DdzDLHmqO5neVLiCjnls8oXgBzCSPEEzTfR2rNHqeXu4eEIDDdldk-uC1Uf2mKWOfDF9E6SxpOgBnRdNm7VIWroeZbtr9Dsy2hS96YPiXLG1AOq8mm3iFhOkt6Kh7gvXBCjCUI58xZekuYNCmP2byv4vGZ20ol9v4TEIbXVXYaySRU02fG82b77-CE7o5ZY4vSx6TTpW6Qjqf2Wa9hFinyE-rirEblgUIU6YZLRFULYeZeuyRL1w_-30Vg4C993Y662DD8O7-oIgJKVeBXlDD92DJ5aISpQvhwfQD0qsDbcJEemfD4mqdGHO0nKSIhAglkiGhxHzQsLvkwxIdggdYpR5JHCgVrXuUxeQHvXyZh9CQSk1-8u0sSJXcuKIpnTYECSTMpogvayu5YgDRaCDTkb0USM2lJ4rfygETyzcUMEjNJKdHGS10dz-vGWWgF0XloufujHQi6H-5LJOhdDzOJzDQozUO4tBbBL05ZhjAB6PE6ugHuCACQ2aMAmnynyFC9wMV9xPjstZys8jpD7Jq729faRK-hTNpA91j_GoDT0qvn6gEPbCccrWIadGmOJyttGFup3Z2t43UI0rMZgCs-7yOI_67osPYJhwrrLpVoHDak16YKiM52RYPcTX2RSodWCHaW2WSvo8ietUfaYFBGDAQg==&c=TnfTM_HwGJ9RljUrC96tInQ7df7eThwe673Pv1ZJlpBS30DDWICg5w==&ch=NoOzZzsFm7dtXFXfz8WamB4__MbhlDPehG6tObpqPVEmgVEgljYVeg==). I have spent my career defending the independent practice of medicine, often as a vocal minority, warning our colleagues about the coming collapse of the healthcare system if left in its current socialist form and the collateral damage it is having to the economic affordability of daily life for every American.

* Defending Medical Autonomy: I am committed to a free-market approach that prioritizes patient-centered care over government mandates, insane inflation and price inequities from clinic to hospitals, predatory vertical consolidation, and private equity poison.

* Real-World Experience: With over 25 years in private practice and running my insurance based-small business in primary care, I know the impact of inflation and rising costs on our clinics and our patients and can passionately prosecute the case.

* Leadership and Service: As a former U.S. Navy Lieutenant Commander and physician to Congress, I have the unique experience needed to fix a broken system from the inside. Post-9/11 you may have seen me taking on "the establishment" globally in my own faith community demanding reform. I will bring that same fearlessness and passion to reforming the American healthcare system and strengthening the House of Medicine again!

We need a voice in Washington that speaks for actual doctors, not the medical establishment elite. *** Please join me and my fellow physicians for a special THIS THURSDAY ***
This Doctor Should be IN (Congress): Fighting Big Healthcare Hosted by: Dr. James Adkins • Janet & Dr. Roger Briggs • Dr. Ralph Heap • Dr. Darrell Wadas Dr. Jess Thompson • Dr. Bob Bullington • Dr. Skip Watters • Dr. Ronnie Dowling • Dr. Gary Figge Dr. Anthony Herro • Dr. Frank Surdakowski (*host committee now forming)

name: John Padora For Colorado
subject: I Hit Rock Bottom. That’s Why I’m Fighting for You.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Padora for Colorado
body:
A car accident. Addiction. A second chance. Now I’m fighting for millions of Americans who feel left behind.

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/qnb3C4znaQY6rdqNkofe6Q~~/AAUS1hA~/xfFIvpemXDSpKI9NbHSOenIvs5FghxgT60Zt6utxdOXy-u0c00sH66WhjI3dSn75-5uOq5k6XK6HGTuXy0jzwJaVghhaJwnrI8ttV90AkVeU-9lnWRUYRgmvUz-R1Jlw)
| | [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/WiyWG4D5nGVnxxWMfcPRJA~~/AAUS1hA~/zRyCnOZPrkZ6KF-IERBiS6Aid_w6_BcFGTBpLdxY1W4K-M53t7e2Tivwsb2IeTmjrhFtsSqEFt_5rbA_jeG3rhW95I3x5t-VpywH_qsmIIm_LYiNCruy5cAVObcDltA-WX-xOaiAIuoDsIacFaKyww~~) **Friend,** Years ago, a **serious car accident changed my life**. The injuries led to pain. The pain led to prescriptions. And eventually, I fell into **addiction**. That road took me to **rock bottom**. One night I sat in a jail cell thinking about everything I had nearly lost - my family, my career, my future. In that moment, I made a decision. **I wasn’t going to give up.** So I rebuilt my life **one step at a time**. I fought for sobriety. I worked with **addiction recovery centers and nonprofits** to help people get the treatment they needed. I advocated for **second-chance programs** to keep non-violent offenders out of jail and give people a path to rebuild their lives. I also fought for **cannabis legislation** because this issue was personal to me. My **father was battling Multiple Sclerosis** and using medical marijuana for relief, yet the law treated him like a criminal. I knew firsthand how cruel and backwards that was. No family should have to watch someone they love suffer while politicians criminalize the care that helps them survive. As the **grandson of a farmer and the son of a nurse and a carpenter** , I know the dignity of hard work. I know what it means to come from people who work with their hands, who care for others, who build things, and who keep this country moving. And I also know this: **Too many people who end up in the halls of Congress do not know hard work - they know privilege, nepotism, and connections.** They do not know what it means to fight through pain, to claw your way back, to worry about medical bills, or to watch the cost of living rise while your paycheck stays the same. But millions of Americans do. That is why **my story is not unique**. Across Colorado, I meet good people - Democrats, Republicans, and independents - who feel like they have been **left behind by a political system that no longer fights for them**. They see the **middle class shrinking**.
They feel the **rising cost of living**.
They watch their **democracy slip further out of reach**. And they know their voices are too often drowned out by **corporate money and political elites**. That is why I am running for Congress. Yes, to replace **Lauren Boebert**. But also for something bigger. **To help build a new era of politics that puts working Americans ahead of the elitists, the corporatists, and the people who have exploited our labor for their own gain.** Over the last 10 months, I have driven **15,000 miles across this district** listening to people who are desperate for leaders who actually understand their struggles. Right now, I am fighting for **ballot access through the caucus and assembly process**. **And I need your help.**
### **If you believe working people deserve a fighter in Washington - not another politician born into privilege - chip in today and help us win this fight.**
******[Together we can replace Lauren Boebert and build a government that finally puts working families first.](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/DU2eC_lB7dGX97ljToGroQ~~/AAUS1hA~/g7p3_2VBqna70-mOt4WbkNSj_xweriFd4vcuLYxITRKU681TDm-o2sf7pPFMV7qpeNzZA-y1bv-wSj6phkCY7Cn76NKmNgxo6hGOU2GR0Yd-xMNCy1ArrhpuUkN6WLZ77d9o7zMgrKChhn7dAJ4sEfqgHvPgRP6wT-JD7i6xctU~)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | [Chip in $10 now >>](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/8lI_DGPBVKC5rbapYBiUaA~~/AAUS1hA~/_ZM79UJFP2QmF8dl9WFShcLyyrD4CDQK36vVcifrsKa8P9ui2qz1UsztUmCPDIdHMxccGHx_Lz9LcSWxWo88jbFNZELcBpx6WxX3VpImrCEREUBUHDDYal2db-nMN6rwg8fycNyWBzBh6wHdQsLDiW8Sdv_b9o5Z51vCMep1iC5K54VwJt5j9kCChWeEjf5m) | [Chip in $25 now >>](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/3RTLfZqEPDZDMPKHPQGu-w~~/AAUS1hA~/_ZM79UJFP2QmF8dl9WFShcLyyrD4CDQK36vVcifrsKa8P9ui2qz1UsztUmCPDIdHMxccGHx_Lz9LcSWxWo88jbFNZELcBpx6WxX3VpImrCHtZydTmvwfPutx1y9ZKh-5WM1MPPT0iZOCtRGH5o1wSHg_HN76lxWfVizRUZjQ-XJv2_dfymWQUK8dJTjvX-Gu)

Peter, this is NOT an email asking for money.
**[Instead, we’re asking for your endorsement in what might be the most important Senate race in the country.](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2026-email/?source=jtk39-su-nd&amount=5&refcode=jtk39-su-nd&t=7&akid=715%2E124072%2EJCMUsd)** Let us explain.
As of last week, Roy Cooper is the official Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate in North Carolina. **This is one of just four toss-up races in 2026 and a _must-win_ for Democrats if we’re going to have any hope of taking back the Senate and breaking the GOP’s hold on Washington.**
Roy has a proven record of winning tough races in battleground North Carolina – in fact, he’s _never_ lost and was twice elected governor in years that Donald Trump carried the state.
The secret to his success – well, it’s not really a secret. It comes down to two things: **1)** delivering on his promises to lower health care costs, improve public education, create job opportunities and provide a better quality of life for every North Carolinian, and **2)** having a strong grassroots team made up of folks like you by his side.
**That’s why your endorsement today is so important, Peter. Now that we’re through the primary, this race is full speed ahead through Election Day, and we’re counting on you to help Roy keep up his momentum.**
**[Will you be one of the 50,000 supporters we need to personally endorse Roy to help us kick off the general election and show the strength of our grassroots movement? Please add your name before midnight.](https://act.roycooper.com/survey/endorse-cooper-2026-email/?source=jtk39-su-nd&amount=5&refcode=jtk39-su-nd&t=8&akid=715%2E124072%2EJCMUsd)**

_As the Campaign kicks off for[Dr. Mike Goldstein for Congress](https://substack.com/redirect/9eddcfc6-d6b5-43b9-975b-46e42a94750f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we have been keeping you informed of all the issues affecting Connecticut and our nation. It is important to know that a federal seat for Connecticut is not state specific._
[](https://substack.com/redirect/22ca82ae-074e-453e-ba4b-9c1a98548f08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
As a nation, America cannot remain strong, prosperous, or secure without reliable and affordable energy. Yet across the Northeast, families and businesses are facing some of the **highest electricity costs in the United States** , largely due to misguided energy policies that have reduced supply while demand continues to grow. Affordability in Connecticut starts with electricity and CT's Public Benefits are hitting CT residents and business owners.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..OBXciKolASJSMtWhWk-P5QV24g1jb7crl4zfWhXG5DU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=190400879)

**Time for the Nuclear Option**
On Friday, Mike Lawler hosted U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright, leaders from Holtec International, and regional officials at the site of the former Indian Point Energy Center to discuss the future of nuclear power in the Hudson Valley.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/17fb166b-8c5d-41e8-930c-fecc2e721020?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

Source - [Mike Lawler Facebook](https://substack.com/redirect/4ed79101-87ce-42c1-b4df-293ea292b008?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
_**Congressman Lawler is right to focus attention on restoring reliable energy production in our region.**_
The closure of Indian Point removed nearly **two gigawatts of reliable, carbon-free electricity** from the grid -- power that supported millions of homes and helped stabilize the regional energy market.
The consequences have been immediate: **higher prices, tighter supply, and greater pressure on surrounding states like Connecticut.**
# Why Connecticut Should Be Concerned
Connecticut has Millstone Power Station -- the single most important energy facility in Connecticut. Operated by Dominion Energy, Millstone provides:
• About **50% of Connecticut 's electricity**
• Over **90% of Connecticut 's carbon-free power**
Connecticut once had three nuclear reactors. Today it relies on just two.
If Connecticut were ever to lose a major nuclear facility like Millstone, the impact would be immediate:
• Electricity prices would surge
• Grid reliability would weaken
• Businesses would leave the region
• Families would face even higher utility bills
The lesson from New York is clear: **prematurely closing reliable power plants without realistic replacements is a costly mistake. We also cannot rely on offshore windmills to guarantee energy generation.**
# The Northeast Energy Security Initiative
As part of the **[Goldstein for Congress campaign](https://substack.com/redirect/9eddcfc6-d6b5-43b9-975b-46e42a94750f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , we are proposing a regional strategy to restore energy reliability and affordability across Connecticut and New York.
The **Northeast Energy Security Initiative** will focus on five priorities:
### 1\. Protect and Expand Nuclear Energy
Protect existing plants like Millstone Power Station while supporting the development of **next-generation nuclear technologies** , including small modular reactors.
### 2\. Repurpose Strategic Energy Sites and Use alternate Nuclear Generation
Support the repurposing of sites like Indian Point Energy Center for advanced nuclear development and clean baseload power. We will also work to repurpose our nuclear submarines for energy generation as 3 of them are equal to the proposed energy of Revolution Wind and will create great state and federal jobs in Connecticut.
The Goldstein Substack
[When Submarines Rise, Connecticut Leads](https://substack.com/redirect/39439a24-6bfe-4c81-84c9-3a4ad16c52c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Connecticut families and businesses are paying some of the highest electricity rates in America. High energy costs function like a hidden tax -- driving away manufacturers, discouraging AI and data center investment, and squeezing middle-class households already stretched thin...
[Read more](https://substack.com/redirect/39439a24-6bfe-4c81-84c9-3a4ad16c52c8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
13 days ago * 7 likes * 2 comments * Dr. Michael Goldstein and Jonathan Goldstein
### 3\. Restore an "All-of-the-Above" Energy Strategy
End the political war on energy production and allow responsible development of nuclear, natural gas, hydropower, and emerging technologies.
### 4\. Strengthen the Regional Grid
Coordinate planning between Connecticut, New York, and New England to ensure grid stability and prevent energy shortages and repeal legislation that gives the Governor of New York veto power on the expansion of natural gas pipelines so desperately needed in Connecticut.
### 5\. Lower Energy Costs for Families and Businesses
Increase energy supply to bring down electricity prices and restore economic competitiveness in the Northeast.
# Energy Security Is Economic Security
_**Energy policy is not an abstract debate.**_
It determines whether families can afford their electricity bills, whether businesses stay in Connecticut, and whether our region remains competitive.
The Northeast should not be a place where energy is scarce and expensive.
With responsible leadership and common-sense policy, Connecticut and New York can become leaders in **reliable, clean, and affordable energy production.**
The goal is simple:
⚡ **More energy production**
⚡ **Stronger grid reliability**
⚡ **Lower electricity costs for American families (especially here in CT)**
That is the mission of the **Northeast Energy Security Initiative**.

Chris Pappas is in a tied race — and Republicans are coming hard for this seat.

Hi, it’s Kentucky Governor Andy Beshear.
There’s a lot of noise in an election year — I know that better than most. But let me be very clear: **The Senate race in New Hampshire could decide the direction of this country.**
Chris Pappas is running in a tied race. It could be a toss-up. And with Donald Trump in the White House, the stakes couldn’t be higher.
**[That’s why I’m asking you to chip in $5, or anything you can, right now to help Chris Pappas win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260309_1.u1cCl4&refcode=em20260309-1&t=2&akid=5487%2E582294%2E8BVDlP)**
The first year of this second Trump Administration has seen chaos, division, and dangerous rollbacks of basic freedoms. That’s why it’s so important we elect leaders like Chris Pappas — leaders who know how to bring people together, deliver real results, and never forget who they’re fighting for.
Chris’s opponent is a former U.S. Senator with national name recognition and the backing of national Republicans and their deep-pocketed super PACs. Republicans believe they can flip this seat and block any chance we have of checking Trump’s power in Washington.
But I believe in Chris — and I believe we can win.
Chris understands that leadership isn’t about grabbing headlines or scoring political points. It’s about showing up, listening, and doing the hard work to deliver for working families. He’s done that in Congress, and I know he’ll bring that same spirit of public service to the Senate.
Kentucky and New Hampshire may look different, but our constituents are people who want the same things: good jobs, strong schools, access to health care, and a future we can build together. That’s what Chris Pappas is fighting for. **_But he can’t do it alone._**

Peter, It happens every year like clockwork. That letter shows up in your mailbox, and you dread opening it, knowing it won’t be good. But when you finally do, it’s even worse than you feared. [**I’m talking about property taxes.**](https://kcforjoco.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d540da3225ec5b2797f3018d2&id=fb43f2ac57&e=7320325a61) Five years ago, Johnson County’s budget was $1.26 billion. In 2025, it ballooned by 45% to $1.83 billion. And what are families getting in return? Not better services or smarter government. Instead, we’re seeing bloated budgets funded on the backs of homeowners. Even worse, seniors on a fixed income risk being completely pushed out by skyrocketing property taxes.
**It’s not right—and it’s not sustainable.**
As a small business owner, I understand what it takes to manage tight budgets, lead teams through uncertain times, and deliver results. So here’s my promise to you: As Commission Chair, I will fight to cut property taxes, rein in runaway spending, and restore fiscal sanity to Johnson County’s budget.**If you’re tired of opening that envelope with dread, stick with me. We’re going to fix this! **

name: Justin Streiff, Turning Point USA
subject: The message Charlie carried into eternity
body:
Please read the message below from our sponsor.
* * *
| | | [](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)
---
**[Support Turning Point USA](https://trk.rightwingreport.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn68p&__onlt=h)**
---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. body:
But I still have faith. Here’s why.
---

---

---
_**A Special Message from our Sponsor**_ _Please note that views expressed in this message do not necessarily reflect those of_ _Parler_ _and do not constitute an endorsement or recommendation by_ _Parler_ _._
---
| Jim Jordan But I still have faith. Here’s why. | | Patriot,
---
The one major problem that’s been haunting Republicans ever since President Trump took office is getting worse and worse...
---
**_Republicans stare down epic voter enthusiasm gap ahead of 2026 midterms_**
---
**“Among registered Democrats, 79 percent said they were certain they would vote in November, compared to just 65 percent of Republicans — the largest advantage Dems have had ahead of the midterms since 2006.” **
---
[Source: _Washington Post_]
---
If those numbers turn out to be true, the President’s House GOP Majority is DOOMED!
---
The good news? _**_There’s still time to change that!_**_
---
To defy history by SAVING the President’s House Majority in the midterms, I believe that Republicans must do three things:
---
1\. Tell the American people what we’ve accomplished.
2\. Tell the American people what we still need to do.
3\. Remind the American people that the Democrats are crazy!

---
_President Trump’s State of the Union achieved #1. The Democrats are doing a great job of achieving #3 on their own – when President Trump asked them point blank to stand if they believe in prioritizing Americans over illegals, the entire party REFUSED!_
---
**That leaves #2: Our party must compile a winning platform for the midterms that unites the vast majority of Americans and ensures every voter sees it, just like we did in 2024!**
---
President Trump already has the perfect solution...
---
**For the first time in history, our Party will hold a midterm convention to codify our party’s platform and broadcast it from coast to coast.**
---
But that winning platform can’t be written in Congress, the West Wing, or even on Air Force One. _Nope!_ It can ONLY be written directly by salt of the earth _grassroots_ voters like _YOU_.
---
That’s why I’m asking for your help today, Patriot.
---
I have faith that, with a winning platform authored by the American people, we’ll defy history once again with a historic midterm victory!
---
[**So please, complete the “2026 GOP Midterm Convention Platform Survey” to help President Trump and the Republican Party craft our winning platform ahead of our historic first-ever midterm convention.**](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
---

[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
---

[TAKE THE SURVEY >> ](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
---

Thank you,
---
[](https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D)
---
Jim Jordan

body:
Every election, our volunteers, neighbors, and small-dollar donors turn out and win the kind of historic victories that change lives. | | | | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqu4ksFa5SF7IXH6Sr7Lz9yT4BJ6wfT9iHGAVELJI9cKPf2l_zO-JI-06hG3RfVAGt-QQzi7EW9K06_rYdMDt2o-0fhZh2mxVlQ_AU9K9NCsMh9wmAYi4VQyf_gvKODkc3zeOtQDvUFj39R2N3SFKmGhR9_dO_TBTpmEvpIZ7B3nDdo49LPpVcXm9nC_lmjJjYfwe3nzh1swGPlZ1dUPhj8vF0EsLnHd-IGA-bt0LLYUebs5SKUaNVLaBXeOEFaYZq6tGiAADGch7y-CSf0q_UOCAMBd7LXuDpaE3OpGMqlVqxAshiMbCzEL4En_ywxSXLstwmNbVjrfI6c1sznmvQoAorJ713a0XytWN9YCwu4BnHanpDfRNBWzucVf5WF2IwE/4os/YlTqEzWKSZOGPTyhlkhxOA/h0/h001.7ySB9hPWhEQlKLM2Oi7fERm1Cx4GNdfmEyNYtnT_lvM)
---
Hey there,
Nevada breaks records because of grassroots people power. Every election, our volunteers, neighbors, and small-dollar donors turn out and win the kind of historic victories that change lives.
**Nevada was the first U.S. state to elect a women-majority legislature.**
That was not decided in a boardroom or by big checks. It was built door by door, phone call by phone call, and dollar by dollar from people who believed change was possible.
Those wins matter because they deliver real results. With a women majority in Carson City we fought for families, for affordable healthcare, for housing solutions, and for protecting bodily autonomy. subject: Charlie wrote this for the soul
body:
[unsubscribe](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?xul=1nmc5a54x67zfmd5fi2bt1ih2tqa7uue59yxpw6wsnsum2d6rfank8xh5ikzi40y3b98jnyju7pkis9zgf3w0wek7cyedpixofbpufibw2sup2m26u5i&__stmp=tbn762&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh)
Please read the message below from our sponsor.

Steve Thompson, Editor
* * *

| | | [](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)
---
| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn’t a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal — the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God’s grace.**

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**“God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold.”**_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)
---
When you read it, you will hear Charlie’s voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie’s hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

**[To claim your copy of this life-changing book, simply make a generous gift in any amount to Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)
---
In the months since Charlie’s assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA’s message among young Americans...

...and it’s not just the conservative message as a whole — _**it’s the message of FAITH!**_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie’s call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it’s happening._

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we’re witnessing is not just growth —**it’s revival.**

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America’s faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up.**

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _“We’re not backing down.”_

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie’s most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie’s faith._**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

**[To claim your copy of Charlie’s final book, simply make a gift, in any amount, to support Turning Point USA today.](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)**
---
[ **Support Turning Point USA**
**& Receive Charlie’s Final Book**](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)
---
I’ll personally ensure your copy is sent to you as soon as possible.

Thank you in advance for carrying on Charlie’s mission and supporting his legacy.
---
**For Charlie,**

**Justin Streiff**
Chief Operating Officer
Turning Point USA
---
[](https://track.americanpatriotdaily.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=tbn762&__onlt=h)

---
**P.S.** When you read **_Stop, in the Name of God,_** you will discover what Charlie found in the Sabbath: a holy rest that steadies the heart, renews the soul, and gives strength for the road ahead.

**[I hope you’ll claim your copy by making your most generous gift to Turning Point USA. Your support fuels our work to build the most faithful generation of Americans in history. body:
Ben Cline says he’ll spend “whatever it takes” to stop this amendment — we need your help to make sure that doesn’t happen.
# [](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/629?refcode=em20260309-296&t=1&akid=296%2E12592%2EaC4_XO)
[](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260309_1.-6Z-G9&amount=3&refcode=20260309-296&t=2&akid=296%2E12592%2EaC4_XO)
**U.S. Rep. Ben Cline just escalated the fight over Virginia’s Fair Elections amendment.**[**Can you rush a donation of $3 to strengthen our movement to vote YES on the Virginia redistricting amendment?**](https://act.virginiansforfairelections.com/go/41?c0=em_ms_vafe_20260309_1.-6Z-G9&amount=3&refcode=20260309-296&t=3&akid=296%2E12592%2EaC4_XO)
Just days ago, he announced his new political group “Stop the Gerrymander” aimed to _“spend what it takes”_ to defeat the amendment that would give voters, not politicians, the final say on congressional maps.
They’re building a statewide get-out-the-vote effort to confuse Virginia voters and urge them to vote NO. At the same time, **we’re organizing across the Commonwealth to do the opposite** — educating voters, cutting through misinformation, and mobilizing Virginians to vote YES so politicians can’t redraw maps behind closed doors.
But this isn’t just coming from one member of Congress.

I was one of the millions of Americans who relied on SNAP.
As a college student working two jobs, I qualified for the program. SNAP benefits were the difference between putting my kids to bed hungry and not.
My colleagues on the other side of the aisle don’t care that there are parents doing everything they can to provide for their families, and it still is not enough to make ends meet.
Millions of families have a similar story — seniors, veterans, people who need help putting healthy food on the table.
But instead of standing up for these families, Republicans have attacked this critical safety net to offer tax cuts for the wealthiest people in the country.
I am fighting in Congress to restore SNAP, but I am also in a competitive district that Republicans want to flip. To win and keep up these fights, I need a strong grassroots coalition behind me.

| | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. # [Florida wealth migration from Blue states now "permanent"](https://substack.com/redirect/a115b1fb-3c0d-4200-9179-50dc07f658e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
More than $126 million dollars in new wealth has flowed into Florida real estate in just the past 60 days as high-net-worth individuals continue their exodus from high-tax blue states, with **[experts now declaring the migration trend permanent.](https://substack.com/redirect/a115b1fb-3c0d-4200-9179-50dc07f658e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a115b1fb-3c0d-4200-9179-50dc07f658e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record wealth inflow:** Florida has absorbed over 126 million dollars in new wealth from high-net-worth migrants in the last 60 days alone according to real estate tracking data.
* **Blue state exodus continues:** Residents from New York, California, Illinois and other high-tax states are driving the sustained influx of capital into Florida properties.
* **Migration becomes permanent:** Industry analysts now describe the movement of wealth and people out of blue states into Florida as a long-term structural shift rather than a temporary trend.
* **Economic impact grows:** The continued arrival of wealthy individuals is boosting local tax revenue and supporting strong demand for luxury real estate across the state.

# [Saudi Aramco slashes output sharply](https://substack.com/redirect/725c7d4a-3933-413a-92c4-7ba1d581a25e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Saudi Aramco is **[cutting production by 500,000 barrels per day](https://substack.com/redirect/725c7d4a-3933-413a-92c4-7ba1d581a25e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** starting in April as OPEC+ members struggle with overflowing storage tanks and stalled tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz amid the ongoing Iran war.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/725c7d4a-3933-413a-92c4-7ba1d581a25e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Output reduction confirmed:** Saudi Aramco will lower its April crude production by 500,000 barrels per day from March levels as the kingdom joins other OPEC+ members in responding to the severe storage crunch caused by the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz.
* **Storage crisis deepens:** Gulf producers are rapidly running out of onshore and floating storage capacity after weeks of near-zero commercial exports through the Strait of Hormuz, forcing unilateral production cuts across multiple countries.
* **OPEC+ coordination strained:** The coordinated output agreement is under significant pressure as several member nations have begun cutting production independently rather than waiting for a formal group decision.
* **Price impact limited:** Despite the announced cuts, Brent crude continues trading well above the $100 per barrel level with analysts warning that the physical supply disruption remains the dominant market factor.

* * *
* * *
# **[G7 panics over triple digit oil](https://substack.com/redirect/9538f5e9-eaf1-42ef-bde2-131c6edc694b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
World leaders from the G7 are **[holding emergency talks](https://substack.com/redirect/9538f5e9-eaf1-42ef-bde2-131c6edc694b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** about **[releasing strategic oil reserves](https://substack.com/redirect/cfa056b8-89af-4f41-9d9b-e7d219928ea6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as Brent crude has surged into triple-digit territory, with growing alarm over the economic consequences of the Iran war and blocked Hormuz shipping.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9538f5e9-eaf1-42ef-bde2-131c6edc694b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Emergency reserve talks:** G7 nations are urgently considering coordinated releases from their strategic petroleum reserves to help calm and stabilize global energy markets.
* **Oil price explosion:** Brent crude has climbed well above the psychologically important 100 dollar per barrel level for the first time in several years.
* **Hormuz shipping paralyzed:** Commercial tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has been almost completely halted for weeks.
* **Economic alarm rising:** Leaders fear that sustained high oil prices will trigger a new wave of global inflation.
* **Limited relief expected:** Analysts caution that even a large SPR release may not be enough to bring oil prices down significantly in the current environment.

* * *
* * *
# [Bitcoin outperforms amid oil surge](https://substack.com/redirect/450a010b-2970-4709-b51f-506bbe448828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bitcoin **[has outperformed most traditional risk assets](https://substack.com/redirect/450a010b-2970-4709-b51f-506bbe448828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as oil prices exploded past 100 dollars per barrel, with many investors now treating cryptocurrency as a hedge against geopolitical uncertainty and rising inflation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/450a010b-2970-4709-b51f-506bbe448828?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bitcoin holds steady:** While stocks and other risk assets declined sharply, Bitcoin remained relatively resilient during the oil price spike.
* **Hedge appeal increases:** Investors are increasingly viewing Bitcoin as an alternative store of value during periods of geopolitical tension.
* **Correlation shifts:** The traditional relationship between Bitcoin and energy prices appears to be breaking down in the current environment.
* **Institutional buying continues:** Large holders and institutions have kept accumulating Bitcoin despite the heightened market volatility.

* * *
* * *
# [Microsoft integrates Claude into 365](https://substack.com/redirect/41102ba7-642f-45b9-9e1d-181042afda16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Microsoft has announced **[a major new partnership with Anthropic](https://substack.com/redirect/41102ba7-642f-45b9-9e1d-181042afda16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that will bring the Claude AI model directly into Microsoft 365 applications including Word, Excel, Teams and Outlook for enterprise customers.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/41102ba7-642f-45b9-9e1d-181042afda16?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Deep Office integration:** Claude AI will now work natively inside the full Microsoft 365 productivity suite for business users worldwide.
* **Enterprise security focus:** The collaboration emphasizes secure deployment of advanced AI tools within corporate environments and workflows.
* **Strategic expansion move:** Microsoft continues to broaden its artificial intelligence offerings beyond its own Copilot platform.
* **Competition intensifies:** The deal represents a direct challenge to OpenAI's strong position in workplace artificial intelligence applications.

* * *
* * *
# [Ford forced to recall every vehicle sold since 2020 (except the Ford GT)](https://substack.com/redirect/229e1600-00a4-489f-bace-29c12531c16e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ford is facing one of its largest recall campaigns in history after safety issues forced the automaker to recall **[nearly every vehicle sold since 2020,](https://substack.com/redirect/229e1600-00a4-489f-bace-29c12531c16e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with only the flagship GT supercar exempt from the sweeping action.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/229e1600-00a4-489f-bace-29c12531c16e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Massive recall scope:** Ford has issued recalls covering almost all models produced from 2020 onward due to multiple defects ranging from braking systems to electrical failures and airbag malfunctions.
* **GT model spared:** The high-performance Ford GT supercar is the only vehicle line that has escaped the current wave of safety-related recalls affecting the rest of the lineup.
* **Safety concerns mount:** Regulators and customers have raised serious questions about quality control at Ford after a string of issues forced widespread vehicle repairs and replacements.
* **Financial pressure rises:** The extensive recall campaign is expected to create significant costs that will impact Ford's margins and profitability throughout the remainder of 2026.

# [In Michigan, we build ](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=190033923&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTkwMDMzOTIzLCJpYXQiOjE3NzMwNzkzMDYsImV4cCI6MTc3NTY3MTMwNiwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.89SgVad8aIiWnIzyorsvjz8jzNipdXl0PBI3xGbW32M)
### Thoughts on Manufacturing Mondays
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Mar 9
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..iuTowA0zIaPz-Hva0w-hgyjP8bT3Qz7ihVddCiwNFiA?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/in-michigan-we-build?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

It's Manufacturing Monday, folks!
And if you know me, you know this is my favorite topic - I'm always geeked to talk about manufacturing.
From the shop floors in Grand Rapids to the tool-and-die makers in Macomb County to the engineers in Dearborn designing the next generation of technology, manufacturing isn't just an industry in Michigan.
**It 's who we are.**
Here, we build.
Manufacturing is about the pride of seeing what you made with your own two hands. It's a career you can raise a family on. It's the sound of machines humming before sunrise and the satisfaction of watching a finished product roll off the line. It's knowing that your work is helping build our country.
**That 's the Michigan way.**
Now, if you've spent any time on factory floors, you know it hasn't always been easy. At times, it's been downright brutal.
Factories have closed. Supply chains have shifted. Entire towns have had to adapt and reinvent themselves in the face of global competition and economic change.
But here's something I've learned after spending my entire career in this fight:
**Michigan doesn 't quit.**
Being the underdog doesn't scare us one bit. When I was serving as chief of staff during President Obama's auto rescue, people across the country were writing off Michigan's auto industry.
They said the jobs were gone. They said the factories were finished. They said American manufacturing couldn't compete.
Well, Michiganders had something to say about that.
We rolled up our sleeves, got to work, and helped save **more than 200,000 Michigan jobs.**
That moment reminded the country what Michigan workers are capable of when we invest in them and believe in them.
And we're still building on that legacy today.
When I helped write the **CHIPS and Science Act** : it was about making sure the next generation of manufacturing - semiconductor production - happens right here in the United States, in places like Michigan.
**Because the future of manufacturing is being written right now.**
Advanced manufacturing. Clean energy technologies. Semiconductor production. Aerospace components. Medical devices.
And Michigan workers are ready to lead the way.
When I travel across our state - from union halls in Genesee County to small manufacturers in Oakland County to suppliers in West Michigan - I see the same thing over and over again:
Pride. Skill. Determination.
The belief that building things still matters.
And it does.
**Manufacturing built the American middle class.** It built the towns and cities across Michigan that still define our state. And if we do this right, it will build the next chapter of American prosperity too.
_That 's why I've spent my career fighting for this industry._
And every Monday, I like to take a moment to recognize the people who make it all possible - the welders, machinists, engineers, technicians, and line workers who keep Michigan moving.
So here's to Manufacturing Monday.
**Here 's to the builders.** Here's to the people who never gave up on Michigan. And here's to the future we're building together.
I'm proud to stand with you.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

body:
Public pressure has worked to make USPS reverse course in the recent past. There's every reason to believe we can get them to roll back this awful postmark change before it invalidates countless eligible ballots in the midterm elections.
Make every mail-in vote count by demanding the USPS restore real-time postmarks ASAP! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Folks,
Due to a USPS change, most of the country’s mail dropped in a blue box or handed to a mail carrier on or before an election deadline is no longer guaranteed to receive a real-time postmark. In some cases, postmarks may not be applied for days. That delay can be the difference between a vote that counts and a vote that gets thrown out.
Postmarks are how election officials decide whether a ballot was mailed on time. When postmarks are delayed, ballots become vulnerable to rejection, legal challenges, and partisan games after Election Day. When mail processing is delayed, postmarks lag, and deadlines become murky for voters who tried to do everything right.
This creates a huge risk of opponents of voting rights pushing to discount ballots after the fact.
We must protect vote by mail! Add your name to send a direct message urging your members of Congress to demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks now >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
START WRITING NOW ⇨ [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]
This change is the direct result of former Postmaster General Louis DeJoy’s Regional Transportation Optimization (RTO) plan that quietly went into effect last year.
DeJoy spent years consolidating mail processing out of local communities and centralized it into massive regional hubs that can be hundreds of miles away, sometimes in another state. That means ballots dropped at neighborhood post offices or blue boxes in most of the country are no longer processed locally.
Rural voters and anyone who lives more than 50 miles from one of these mega processing centers are hit hardest – so, most of the country. Many of us rely on mail service for casting our votes, getting prescriptions, paying rent and mortgages, the list goes on. Seniors, veterans, and voters without easy access to in-person voting are especially at risk. Republicans and Democrats alike depend on timely postmarks to ensure their votes count.
The good news is that when it comes to the Postal Service, public pressure works! It worked when we forced DeJoy to pause processing plant consolidation chaos. It worked when Congress intervened to protect election mail in past cycles. It worked when we blocked Trump’s attempt to move the USPS under the control of the Commerce Department and when the administration floated the idea of firing the entire Board of Governors.
Demand the USPS restore real-time postmarks and protect vote by mail today! >> [https://actionnetwork.org/letters/protect-vote-by-mail/?source=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&referrer=group-integrity-first-voter-action-project&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsecure.actblue.com%2Fdonate%2Fifvap-actions]

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
https://www.facebook.com/voteraction [https://www.facebook.com/voteraction] https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org [https://bsky.app/profile/voteractionproject.org] https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/ [https://www.instagram.com/voteractionproj/] https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/ [https://www.linkedin.com/company/voter-action-project/]
Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.
Your support is crucial to our efforts. Will you donate today to help us protect voting rights? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/integrity-first-voter-action-project-1?refcode=030926_2&amount=20]
